display.purpose: Hero headline only, stacked one phrase per line, uppercase, two-layer text shadow.

title.purpose: Zone names and smaller stencil titles, uppercase.

numeral.purpose: Keyframe numbers, part numbers, dive years.

label.purpose: Every tab and field label, uppercase.

label-sm.purpose: Data terms over readouts and facts, depth marks, uppercase.

body.purpose: Running text as typed workshop notes, 46 to 52ch.

readout.purpose: Live and compared values with tabular figures.

shadows.name: lift-sm
shadows.purpose: Filter. Resting lift of tabs, strips and keyframe tabs.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Filter. Hover and active lift of tabs.

shadows.name: figure-cast
shadows.purpose: Filter. Paper figures casting onto the board.

shadows.name: well
shadows.purpose: Diorama window pressed into the box.

shadows.name: display-text
shadows.purpose: Text shadow on the hero display line.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All state transitions and linkage fills.

motion.name: tab-lift
motion.purpose: Tab and keyframe lift on hover.

motion.name: master-clock
motion.purpose: Scene motion (linkage swing, strata translate, sub bob) is a function of the crank value, never a timer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations collapse; smooth scroll off.

components.name: Paper Tab
components.description: Default control: notched pulp-paper tab with a punched slot mark.
components.css: .ds-tab { --ds-bg: var(--paper, #e9e3d6); position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px 8px 30px; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.1; filter: var(--lift-sm); transition: transform .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); } .ds-tab::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--ds-bg); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; width: 4px; height: 16px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--board-deep, #070b10); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .8), 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25); } .ds-tab:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .5)); transition-duration: .08s; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--paper, #e9e3d6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Commitment Tab
components.description: Crimson tab for the briefing request and final descent only.
components.css: .ds-tab-crimson { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px 8px 30px; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--paper, #e9e3d6); font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; filter: var(--lift-sm); transition: transform .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); } .ds-tab-crimson::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--crimson-btn, #b3242b); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-tab-crimson::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; width: 4px; height: 16px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--board-deep, #070b10); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .8), 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25); } .ds-tab-crimson:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-tab-crimson:active { transform: translateY(1px); filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .5)); transition-duration: .08s; } .ds-tab-crimson:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--paper, #e9e3d6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ash Tab
components.description: Pressed-ash tab for secondary actions on the board.
components.css: .ds-tab-ash { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 24px 8px 30px; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--paper, #e9e3d6); font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; filter: var(--lift-sm); transition: transform .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); } .ds-tab-ash::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--ash, #2a3440); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-tab-ash::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; width: 4px; height: 16px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--board-deep, #070b10); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .8), 1px 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .25); } .ds-tab-ash:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-tab-ash:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--paper, #e9e3d6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Paper Field
components.description: Notched paper text field with painted slot mark, inset press, ink focus ring and crimson error ring.
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 28px; border: 0; font-family: var(--f-note); font-size: 1.0625rem; background: linear-gradient(var(--board-deep), var(--board-deep)) 12px 50% / 4px 16px no-repeat, var(--grain), var(--paper, #e9e3d6); background-blend-mode: normal, multiply, normal; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); clip-path: var(--notch); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .18); caret-color: var(--crimson-btn, #b3242b); transition: box-shadow .25s var(--ease); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--ink-text, #14161a); } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--crimson-btn, #b3242b); }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Radio choice as a paper-grey notched chip; checked inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-choice { position: relative; display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px 8px 24px; font-family: var(--f-note); font-size: .95rem; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); background: linear-gradient(var(--board-deep), var(--board-deep)) 10px 50% / 4px 14px no-repeat, var(--grain), var(--paper-2, #cbc3b1); background-blend-mode: normal, multiply, normal; clip-path: var(--notch); transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-choice input:checked + span { background: linear-gradient(var(--paper-3), var(--paper-3)) 10px 50% / 4px 14px no-repeat, var(--ink-text, #14161a); color: var(--paper, #e9e3d6); } .ds-choice:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px dashed var(--ink-text, #14161a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Sticky bar fading from board to transparent: brand tab, paper-grey nav tabs, crimson CTA right.
components.html: HADALLa bajadaLas zonas
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px var(--gutter, 32px); background: linear-gradient(var(--board, #0b1118) 70%, rgb(11 17 24 / 0)); } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--paper, #e9e3d6); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-display); font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.6rem; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: var(--crimson-btn, #b3242b); clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-nav-tab { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px 8px 24px; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; font-size: .92rem; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; filter: var(--lift-sm); transition: transform .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); } .ds-nav-tab::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--paper-2, #cbc3b1); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-nav-tab:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--paper, #e9e3d6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Zone Keyframe Tab
components.description: Signature: one tab per ocean zone; active tab turns pulp paper, slides out 8px, numeral turns crimson.
components.css: .ds-kf { position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: 152px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: "num name" "num range"; column-gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); filter: var(--lift-sm); transition: transform .35s var(--ease), filter .35s var(--ease); } .ds-kf::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--paper-2, #cbc3b1); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: var(--notch); } .ds-kf:hover { transform: translateX(-3px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-kf[aria-current="true"] { transform: translateX(-8px); filter: var(--lift); } .ds-kf[aria-current="true"]::before { background: var(--grain), var(--paper, #e9e3d6); background-blend-mode: multiply; } .ds-kf-num { grid-area: num; font-family: var(--f-display); font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink-muted, #4a4740); } .ds-kf[aria-current="true"] .ds-kf-num { color: var(--crimson, #c22e34); } .ds-kf-name { grid-area: name; font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-kf-range { grid-area: range; font-family: var(--f-note); font-size: .72rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #4a4740); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kf:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--paper, #e9e3d6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Caption Strip
components.description: Paper strip with a swallowtail right edge naming a species.
components.html: Pulpo dumbo Grimpoteuthis. Se ha filmado a casi 7.000 m.
components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-block; max-width: 52ch; padding: 12px 16px 12px 24px; color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); font-family: var(--f-note); font-size: .95rem; filter: var(--lift-sm); } .ds-strip::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--paper, #e9e3d6); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 10px) 50%, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-strip strong { font-family: var(--f-label); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strip em { color: var(--ink-muted, #4a4740); }

components.name: Briefing Sheet
components.description: Pulp-paper sheet with a 14px notch, pinned to the board with an ink push pin.
components.html:
Solicita el briefing

Preparación, seguridad, el sumergible y las fechas posibles.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; isolation: isolate; max-width: 1100px; padding: clamp(32px, 5vw, 72px); color: var(--ink-text, #14161a); font-family: var(--f-note); filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .5)) drop-shadow(0 30px 40px rgb(0 0 0 / .55)); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--grain), var(--paper, #e9e3d6); background-blend-mode: multiply; clip-path: polygon(14px 0, calc(100% - 14px) 0, 100% 14px, 100% calc(100% - 14px), calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 14px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 14px), 0 14px); } .ds-sheet::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 50%; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: -7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-text, #14161a); box-shadow: 0 3px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / .45); } .ds-sheet-title { font-family: var(--f-display); font-weight: 900; font-size: 2.6rem; line-height: .9; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet p { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--ink-muted, #4a4740); }

narrative.overview:
HADAL is cut and slotted paper laid on an abyssal board. Pulp-white stock forms every figure, tab, label and sheet; paper grey and pressed ash are the secondary stocks; the board underneath is a near-black blue carried by fiber and grain overlays. Depth comes from real cast shadows (filter drop-shadows) under paper that is physically lifted off the board, never from glows or gloss.

The system is mechanical. A single crank is the master clock: linkages swing with its angle, strata translate, and nothing in the scene moves on its own timer. Crimson is the only chromatic accent and it is rationed: red is the first color the sea swallows, so it marks only what is moving, what is committed and what has gone wrong.

Type is workshop lettering: stencil caps for display, condensed heavy caps for every label and tab, and a typewriter face for running text and readouts, as if notes were typed onto the board.
keyCharacteristics: Paper on board: light stock figures on a dark fiber ground, with grain multiplied into every paper fill.
Every control is a notched paper tab with a punched slot mark.
Lift through drop-shadow filters on the element, never box-shadow on a clipped shape.
One rationed crimson for motion, commitment and error.
Stencil, condensed caps and typewriter: three voices, each with one job.
Crank-driven motion only; reduced motion collapses all transitions.

rules.name: The Swallowed Red Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears only on what moves, what commits and what fails: active figure parts, the crank knob, the active keyframe numeral, commitment tabs, one headline line, the brand mark, selection and error. Any other crimson is a defect.

rules.name: The Depth Means Darker Rule
rules.body: Water color is indexed to depth through the zone ramp. Deeper content gets a darker zone, never a lighter or more saturated one.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Stencil speaks headings and numerals, condensed caps label things, typewriter explains and measures. Don't set running text in caps or headings in Courier.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or is compared (readouts, depth marks, ranges, times) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Lift Follows The Cut Rule
rules.body: Any clipped paper shape is lifted with a drop-shadow filter on the element and painted by its ::before. Never put box-shadow on a clip-pathed shape; the clip cuts the shadow away.

rules.name: The Hover Lifts Rule
rules.body: Hover raises paper (2 to 3px translate plus the larger lift) and press pushes it down (1px, short shadow, 80ms). No color shifts on hover.

dos: Do build every new control as a notched paper tab: clip-path: var(--notch) on ::before, fill with grain multiplied into the stock, slot mark at left, lift with --lift-sm.
Do keep text on paper in ink (ink-text, ink-muted) and text on the board in paper (paper, paper-grey).
Do drive scene motion from the crank value (manual or autoplay) with the cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) ease, and collapse every transition under reduced motion.
Do separate sections with 2px dashed ash rules and generous s8 / s9 spacing.
Do use tabular figures for every live or compared number.
donts: Don't use crimson outside the Swallowed Red Rule's list.
Don't round the corners of paper; radius is only for pins, discs, slots and the crank.
Don't put box-shadow on a clip-pathed element or shift color on hover; lift it.
Don't add ambient or timer-driven scene animation, glows or glowing particle fields. Marine snow is printed as static paper dots in the middle strata only.
Don't use the zone ramp for UI chrome; it paints water by depth.
